news.headline: Overnight: NQ futures ~+0.4% (~29,560), ES ~+0.2%, YM flat. WTI Dec ~$101 (-0.7%).
news.why: The bounce is holding overnight and CDNS AH adds a chip tailwind. Globex highs are the first liquidity target at 9:30.

news.headline: SOX +2.8% Monday but still -12.2% for October. CME FedWatch shows only a ~13% chance of a hike Wednesday. Nov 3 midterms are next week.
news.why: Semis are deeply oversold, so short squeezes can run. Wednesday is a hold-vs-hike tone question, not a cut debate.

news.headline: Cadence (CDNS) beats and raises after the close: Q3 revenue $1.63B (+22%), 2026 growth guide lifted to 21%, record $8.2B backlog; shares ~+2.6% after hours.
news.why: First AI-chip demand check of the week came in strong, a small tailwind for semis into Tuesday's open.

news.headline: Stocks snap the slide: Nasdaq +0.82% to 26,169, S&P +0.70% to 7,677, Dow +0.28%. NDX was up ~1.2% intraday.
news.why: Relief bounce into Fed/earnings week. It needs MSFT/GOOGL to confirm, or it rolls over.

news.headline: Anthropic publicly files its S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO: $16.3B revenue in H1, $9B spent on AI infrastructure, and an $80.7B net loss, mostly non-cash.
news.why: Revived the AI-demand story. Chips (NVDA, AVGO, MU) rallied and led NQ.

news.headline: Trump on Iran: 'There will not be a strike today.' Oil eases, with WTI ~$101-102 and Brent ~$110-112. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia keep supply risk alive.
news.why: Cheaper oil eases inflation and yield pressure, which helps NQ. The 'today' wording leaves gap risk open.

news.headline: 10Y Treasury slips back under 5% (4.99%); the 2Y is up to ~4.71%. Markets price a ~90% chance the Fed holds Wednesday.
news.why: Long-end relief supports tech multiples. The risk is a hawkish-hold tone from Warsh.

news.headline: Meta plans to raise up to $95B for its AI build-out, starting with a $35B stock sale.
news.why: More AI capex supply. It's bullish for chips but keeps the AI-ROI and dilution worries alive for mega caps.

news.headline: Tesla +6% after Barclays upgrades it to Overweight with a $450 target. Lumentum +8-10% and Coherent +5.5% on optical-networking strength.
news.why: Broad tech participation beyond NVDA supported the NQ bounce.

news.headline: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to ~60,000 employees ahead of Wednesday's earnings; the stock edged higher.
news.why: Cost-cutting while AI capex runs hot. Sets up Wednesday's MSFT print, the #1-weight driver.

news.headline: Brazil ETF (EWZ) crashes ~21% after Lula's reelection; the real loses 10%+.
news.why: EM shock that stayed contained. Watch for a dollar bid and risk-off spillover if it spreads.

takeaway: NQ futures are holding Monday's bounce overnight (~+0.4%) after the Nasdaq closed +0.82% and the S&P +0.70%, snapping a 2-week slide. Chips led (SOX +2.8%, still -12% for the month) on Anthropic's S-1, and Cadence beat and raised AH (~+2.6%). Oil is softer (WTI ~$101) on Saudi-Iran talks, and the 10Y is ~4.99%. Today: red folder Core Durables 8:30 and CB Confidence 10:00. Wednesday decides the week: FOMC 2 PM (hold ~87%, small hike risk), Warsh 2:30, then MSFT/GOOGL AMC.
